question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Guide $108B ±2% (zero China DC compute); consensus ~$108.8-109.2B. Reference class: NVDA actual vs own guide midpoint over the last ~8 quarters, beats of +2.5% to +7.9%, typically 4-6% (Q2 FY27: $91B guide -> $96.2B, +5.7%). A 5% beat implies ~$113.4B. Thin Polymarket DC-revenue ladder (DC>$105B at 55%, ~$2.3k volume) implies total ~$113B, consistent. Huang scandal/downgrades post-date the quarter's close, so they shouldn't affect booked revenue. Supply constraints cap the upside; >$116B needs a >7.4% beat (~9%). No human total-revenue market found (Kalshi page rate-limited).

- Q2 FY27 (8-K, Aug 2026): revenue $96.2B (+18% q/q, +106% y/y); Data Center $89.0B (92.5% of total). Q3 FY27 outlook: $108B ±2% ($105.8-110.2B), GM ~74%, assumes zero China DC compute revenue.
- Q2 FY27 guide was ~$91B; actual $96.22B = +5.7% vs guide midpoint; vs street ~$92.1B (tradune/hudson-labs, Aug 2026).
- Approximate historical beats vs guide midpoint: Q3 FY25 32.5->35.1 (+7.9%); Q4 FY25 37.5->39.3 (+4.9%); Q1 FY26 43->44.1 (+2.5%, H20 export hit); Q2 FY26 45->46.7 (+3.9%); Q3 FY26 54->57.0 (+5.6%); Q4 FY26 65->68.1 (+4.8%); Q1 FY27 ~78->81.6 (~+4.6%); Q2 FY27 91->96.2 (+5.7%). Base rate over last 8 quarters: beat range +2.5% to +7.9%, central ~+5%. Over those 8: 1 of 8 beat by >7.4% (the threshold for >$116B).
- Consensus Q3 FY27 revenue: LSEG ~$109.2B; MarketBeat ~$108.8B (previews, Nov 2026).
- Earnings date: Nov 17, 2026, after close (previews); before the question's Nov 25 resolution date.
- Nov 11, 2026: Baird downgraded to Neutral (PT $500->$200) on board probe of CEO Huang's alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy; Morgan Stanley removed NVDA as a top pick. Company says Huang continues as CEO. Quarter already closed (late Oct), so this bears on guidance and stock, not the reported Q3 number.
- Previews mention ~$279B supply commitments; supply constraints are a possible cap on upside.
- Thin Polymarket Q3 Data Center revenue ladder (low volume, wide spreads) exists; DC ~92-93% of total.
- Status quo: Nvidia reports above its guide midpoint, as it has every quarter in recent history.
- Resolves off the total revenue in the Q3 FY27 earnings release/8-K (initial figure), not segment revenue or later revisions.
- Event window: first quarterly release after Sep 30, 2026 -> before Jan 1, 2027; as of Nov 14 the release has not happened (expected Nov 17).
- Searched, not found: a Kalshi total-revenue market (page rate-limited); any Nvidia pre-announcement or guidance revision.
